races.display_title: Market Square Monasterevin Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict: BENOWN made a promising start to his career when runner-up here last month, beaten only by a more streetwise rival, and he can build on that effort to go one better. Controlla is feared most dropped into a maiden for the first time, while Heralds March is one to note with his debut run behind him. BENOWN (IRE) CONTROLLA (IRE) HERALDS MARCH (IRE)

races.display_title: Kwiff More Bang For Your Bet Rated Race
races.verdict: A case can be made for most of these but INVINCIBLE WILL rates the pick at these weights and is fancied to bag a second C&D success at the chief expense of recent Leopardstown third Killashee Warrior . Lewis Carroll remains unexposed and can't be discounted after an absence, while Oro Blanco also needs factoring into this competitive event. INVINCIBLE WILL (IRE) KILLASHEE WARRIOR LEWIS CARROLL (IRE)

races.display_title: bet365 Cambridgeshire (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict: The Gosden stable's prowess in this race is well known, particularly with 3-y-os, and GAVRIEL looks just the type to enhance that record. His defeat of Balzac at Ascot earlier in the month was strongly boosted when that one landed a good prize at Newbury last Saturday and this Frankel colt can make light of a 4-lb penalty. Erzindjan , Wild Thoughts and Harmonics , another low-mileage 3-y-o from the Gosden stable, head the many dangers. GAVRIEL ERZINDJAN (IRE) WILD THOUGHTS (IRE)

races.display_title: Blandford Bloodstock 25th Anniversary EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The market should prove highly revealing but the vote goes to RUBY SANDS who shaped well on her debut when third at Newbury and can build on it to get off the mark with Tom Marquand aboard. Roger Varian continues among the winners and his newcomers Miss Jane Hadley (second choice) and Out Late both make plenty of appeal. Queen Of The Gulf and Aquila D'Oro are other debutantes who also command respect in this intriguing juvenile maiden. RUBY SANDS MISS JANE HADLEY (IRE) OUT LATE (IRE)

races.display_title: Ripon Cathedral City Of The Dales Handicap
races.verdict: EYE OF DUBAI bounced back to form in no uncertain terms last week and looks well treated as he attempts to win this race for an incredible third time in a row. He may ideally want softer ground, but he scored on good going in this race last year and looks sure to go well. His biggest danger may be his in-form stablemate Dark Thirty , while Another Baar is lurking from falling mark and could go well at bigger odds. EYE OF DUBAI DARK THIRTY (IRE) ANOTHER BAAR

races.verdict: SHOWTIME MAHOMES took a step in the right direction when third last time and races from the same career-low mark here so he's taken to resume winning ways. Big Apple Jack finally broke his duck last time and should go well from just a 3 lb higher mark, while Good Karma is so consistent that he's hard to see being out of the frame. SHOWTIME MAHOMES BIG APPLE JACK GOOD KARMA

races.verdict: HURSTWOOD won twice at Redcar before completing a hat-trick over C&D in September 2022 and is taken to repeat the feat 4 years on. Kings Merchant has his 2 lb rise for his recent Catterick success more than offset by the promising Conor Whiteley's claim and is second choice ahead of Valentine Catcher and Angel Summer . HURSTWOOD KINGS MERCHANT VALENTINE CATCHER

races.verdict: GALWAY REEL was no match for Huckleberry Sting over C&D in July but now meets that rival on 12 lb better terms now setting out for Olly Murphy, so it's reasonable to believe he can reverse the form and land this race for a second year running. races.display_title: Block Free Services Lincoln Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: The Twiston-Davies team usually has their string ready to roll at this time of year (well-backed winner at Perth on Thursday) and UN SENS A LA VIE is fancied to make it 3-3 at this course. He's narrowly preferred to Indian River , who returns on the back of a progressive juvenile season, with Indemnity the pick of the older horses following his storming run in the Summer Hurdle here. UN SENS A LA VIE (FR) INDIAN RIVER (IRE) INDEMNITY (IRE)

races.verdict: The fences got in the way for the THE CLONMEL KID here last time so he's an interesting one for a return to hurdling off what could be a winnable mark. Ramaah is weighted to turn the tables on Matoury on their C&D form in July and that pair may provide the main opposition. THE CLONMEL KID (IRE) RAMAAH MATOURY

races.display_title: British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Roger Varian continues among the winners and his KAGUYAHIME is fancied to add to the tally on the back of a promising initial third at Ascot, form which gives her the clear edge here. Karl Burke's She's Got A Way rates the chief threat if, as expected, taking a sizeable step forward from her debut Doncaster third over this longer trip. My Girl Dee Mo and Woollahra can fight it out for minor honours. KAGUYAHIME (IRE) SHE'S GOT A WAY (IRE) MY GIRL DEE MO (IRE)

races.display_title: Forever Our Mike Handicap
races.verdict: No shortage of chances in a good quality sprint handicap but 3-y-o ANGEL GABRIEL marked himself out as one to keep on side this autumn when making all at Windsor 4 weeks ago and a 4 lb rise in the weights doesn't look prohibitive with forecast conditions firmly in his favour. Art Lover has shaped well on all 4 starts this season and is a threat, along with Ayr Bronze Cup second Rousing Encore . Storm Force and Golden Long , if handling conditions are others to factor in. ANGEL GABRIEL (IRE) ART LOVER (IRE) ROUSING ENCORE (IRE)

races.display_title: Dance Through The Decades Christmas Parties EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: ROMOTOSO showed form akin to that of her debut when finding only one too good in a Windsor novice 3 weeks ago and a repeat may well be enough to see William Knight's filly get off the mark. Inglewood and Shaniko are 2 live threats, though, with Mollisha also needing to be factored in having had a plausible excuse at Chester last time. ROMOTOSO INGLEWOOD SHANIKO

races.verdict: ELYAM made light work of a 2-year absence to score in facile fashion on debut for this yard and he can make a successful transition into handicap company. races.verdict: HYPNOTISED shaped well from some way back at Doncaster 2 weeks ago and Harry Charlton's 3-y-o gets the nod here ahead of Moulin Booj . Kylian remains on a very eye-catching mark and could also have a say if things pan out more favourably for him this time. HYPNOTISED MOULIN BOOJ (IRE) KYLIAN (IRE)

races.display_title: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict: CARAGIO shaped best before his stamina ran dry in a well-run edition of the 'Leger Legends' at Doncaster just over a fortnight ago, so he's very much of interest back at 7f on his return to handicap company. Recent 3-y-o scorer Justice Court remains unexposed after just 4 career starts, while Packetofbiscuits , a dual C&D winner earlier in the year, is also one to bear in mind having returned to his best when edged out only by a course specialist at Yarmouth recently. CARAGIO (IRE) JUSTICE COURT (IRE) PACKETOFBISCUITS

races.verdict: MASSIMO BLUE made a fine start for this yard when winning twice over C&D last month and he can regain the winning thread after a rare slow break put him on the back foot last time. The reliable Come On Over is also shortlisted alongside Mr Cool , who should benefit from the step back up to 6f. MASSIMO BLUE COME ON OVER (IRE) MR COOL (IRE)
